title: View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF still lets a user create invoices and take payments if Invoicing & payments allows it
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View and Create & Edit, See Financial Data ON, and View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and create an invoice.
  2. Take a payment.
custom_expected:
Both work.

Only the AP/AR-specific views (tabs, reports, sensitive fields) are hidden; invoicing still works.
evidence: UI/perms: AP/AR Data OFF still allows creating invoices/taking payments when Invoicing allows — Service Advisor has invoicingPaymentsCreateAndEdit+Delete with AP/AR off; invoicing capability is independent of AP/AR.
